caption: Physical Site
description: The Physical Site object describes a physical site, such as a campus, facility, or property, as defined by the reporting organization, and the location within it where the activity occurred: the building, the floor, and the site zone.
name: physical_site

building.description: The building within the physical site.

floor.description: The floor or level within the building.

name.description: The name of the physical site, as defined by the reporting organization.

site_zone.description: The site zone within the physical site where the activity occurred.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the physical site, as defined by the reporting organization.
